findings.note: IN Senate, SB 10 - Doriot: Motion Passed (roll call 352), 2025-04-07: yea (tally 39–9); census gate: none.

Fox59 (2025-04-17) names Garten as one of three Senate authors of SB 10. The bill says an ID document 'does not include a document issued by an educational institution', adds voter-list maintenance steps (including notices where proof of citizenship was not provided) and a check with other states for duplicate registration. Passed House 2025-04-01 and Senate 2025-04-07; signed by the governor.
